create_cider_instance: create a Cider instance to compute the CIDEr metric for image description evaluation
compute_cider_score: compute the CIDEr score by passing ground truth and result dictionaries to the Cider class
test_cider_compute_score: test the Cider compute_score method with ground truth and hypothesis dictionaries
review_cider_class: review the Cider class and its compute_score method for image description evaluation
summarize_cider_method: summarize the Cider class method that returns the metric name as a string
